text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Haiku claimed officer on Day 1 and said Sol was the killer, but Sol counterclaimed officer and named Haiku as the killer. The town voted Haiku out 4 to 3 on Day 1, and Luna was killed on Night 2. On Day 2, Sol was voted out 3 to 2 after pushing hard to vote Gemma, and Sonnet was killed on Night 3. On Day 3, Terra caught Opus revising the Sonnet motive, and Opus was voted out 2 to 1. Every killer was out, so the town won.
